tweetText: Samsung Electronics is rolling out ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex to its global workforce, one of the biggest uses of OpenAI’s AI in a company. This move highlights the growing trend of AI integration in the workplace. via OpenAI News

The Trump administration is tightening regulations on Anthropic, raising questions about the future of AI innovation. This could reshape the AI landscape and affect competition in the industry. via TechCrunch AI
Apple's iOS 27 is set to introduce practical AI features beyond just an upgraded Siri. These updates could enhance user experience and productivity on iPhones. via TechCrunch AI
AI is making World Cup scams, like fake tickets and cloned websites, harder to spot. This puts fans at risk of losing money and missing out on the event. via WIRED AI
